items.title: File Barbour County business personal property return
items.description: West Virginia commercial businesses report tangible personal property located in the county as of July 1 on the Commercial Business Property Return (STC 12:32-C), due September 1 for the next calendar tax year. Late or missing returns may result in a $25 to $100 penalty.
